reason: Adds a persistent Favorites section and favorite toggles for DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions, primarily enhancing sidebar navigation and session organization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可持久化的收藏侧栏和会话收藏切换功能，帮助用户整理工作区会话。
summaries.en: Adds a persistent Favorites sidebar and favorite toggles for DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions to improve session organization.

capabilities: Adds a Favorites section to the web sidebar
Adds favorite and unfavorite actions to workspace session menus
Persists favorite session references in the host settings document
Uses documented host package forks to provide required UI and settings integration
